description:
## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-census-claim-capture`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-census-claim-capture -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `records/a2a-registry/2026-09-22.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `verify_anon.py`
- `SCALE-LIMITS.md`
- `runs/2026-09-22.json`
- `runs/2026-09-23.json`
- `index/2026-09-22.json`
- `index/2026-09-23.json`
- `records/a2a-registry/2026-09-22.jsonl`
- See the Data tab for all 128 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

- 128 files, 70,493,703 bytes. File types: .json (53), .ots (36), .txt (18), .jsonl (18), .md (2), .py (1).
- Hugging Face twin: [csoai/claim-capture-census](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/claim-capture-census). 127 of 128 files have the same byte size there.
- Expected update frequency: never.
